decisions.reason: Builds directly on the firm's existing electrical and marine systems knowledge, allowing it to interpret results and improve the product.
General interior lighting is distant from the firm's established industrial/marine knowledge, limiting its ability to assimilate market feedback and improve the product.
Microprismatic optics requires specialised optical knowledge that the firm lacks, reducing its capacity to interpret results and apply commercial learning.
Related to existing marine lighting/searchlight competencies, giving the firm the absorptive capacity to learn and refine it.
